messages:
jamie: tiny maintenance/help request root: i opened a PR to backport the auth/retry small fix to the 2.x gem branch. CI is failing in the matrix for ruby-2.7 (bundler mismatch) and ruby-3.2 (flaky auth test). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1337

Tess: can you paste the failing job output? is it bundler complaining about lockfile version or gem activation errors?

jamie: for 2.7 job the error is `You must use Bundler 2.4 or greater` even though we vendor a Gemfile.lock. For 3.2 it's a flaky `401` in the auth-refresh spec only on windows and musl images.

ci-bot: workflow ruby-ci (matrix: ruby-version=2.7,bundler=2.4)  job failed. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/9023

harry: bundler mismatch usually means the runner's bundler and the lockfile BOM disagree. in GH actions use `gem install bundler -v 2.4.13` before `bundle install` or use `actions/setup-ruby` with bundler: '2.4.13'. e.g. snippet: ```yaml
- name: Install bundler
  run: gem install bundler -v 2.4.13
- name: Install gems
  run: bundle _2.4.13_ install --jobs 4 --retry 3
```

jamie: ok i'll pin bundler in the 2.x workflow and push. about the auth flake on 3.2 windows: it seems to surface only when the CI runner's clock skews a little, causing token expiry to be evaluated as expired. locally can't repro.

Tess: two quick routes: mock time in the test (freeze time around token issue) or make the test retry once with a fresh token if it sees a 401 from auth service. prefer the mock in unit tests to avoid network noise.

jamie: i like mock time for unit test; for integration sampleapp i'll add a retry wrapper. also a community contributor asked in the issues about how to run sampleapp on Ruby 2.7 + Windows; i'll add a short note once we stabilize CI.

community-bot: new issue referenced by PR: community/ruby-windows-run-2.7 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/community/issues/88)

harry: for backporting the gemspec, ensure we don't change runtime dependencies in 2.x branch. keep the gemspec change minimal: just bump the dependency that fixes retry logic, add a deprecation note in the changelog. sample patch: ```ruby
spec.add_dependency "redwood-auth", ">= 1.4.0", "< 2.0"
```

jamie: will keep it minimal. tagging @tess for review once CI is green. i'll push bundler pin + test mock change and a tiny changelog entry. if windows job still flakes, i can gate it behind CI_WINDOWS_FLAKY=true and file a follow-up to investigate infra clock drift.

ci-bot: jamie pushed commit 7c9b2e. pipeline retriggered for matrix jobs.

Tess: thanks! happy to review. also suggest adding a note in the repo README about supported ruby/bundler combinations for community contributors to reduce onboarding friction.

jamie: good call. adding a "local dev" section to README with `rbenv` + bundler pin instructions and a short Windows note. will update this thread once everything passes. :pray:
